Multi-year Owner FCF conversion is healthy at 83.6%. At $94.81 (17.10x peak Owner EPS), CRH trades slightly Below PAR (-2.2% vs PAR Value of $96.92, PAR multiple 17.48x), generating a steady 9.05% 5Y expected IRR (including 1.58% dividend yield).
